---
title: "HindiBabyNet Prosody Statistical Analysis Report"
author: "Arun Prakash Singh"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    toc: yes
    toc_float: yes
    number_sections: yes
    code_folding: show
    df_print: paged
params:
  run_workflow: true
  nsim: 1000
  model_robustness_mode: "strict"
  family1_age_specification: "linear"
  family2_count_age_specification: "linear"
  family2_duration_age_specification: "linear"
  confidence_level: 0.95
  speaker_reference_level: "adult_female"
  child_sex_reference_level: "female"
  city_reference_level: "CNB"
  primary_acoustic_measures: !r c("median_F0_Hz", "robust_pitch_range_Hz", "wav2vec_PC1", "wav2vec_PC2", "wav2vec_PC3", "hubert_PC1", "hubert_PC2", "hubert_PC3")
  sensitivity_acoustic_measures: !r c("mean_F0_Hz", "mean_F0_ST", "median_F0_ST", "robust_pitch_range_ST")
  show_code: true
knit: (function(input, ...) { source(file.path(dirname(input), "..", "shared", "paths.R")); rmarkdown::render(input, output_dir = hbn_results(hbn_read_config(file.path(dirname(input), "..")), "prosody-stats"), envir = globalenv()) })
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = params$show_code, warning = TRUE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE, fig.align = "center", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5.5, dpi = 120
)
options(width = 120, scipen = 999)

# The report runs from the folder of this file.
report_root <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = report_root)
collapse_param_values <- function(values) {
  values <- trimws(as.character(unlist(values, use.names = FALSE)))
  paste(values[nzchar(values)], collapse = ";")
}
report_overrides <- c(
  HBN_PROSODY_NSIM = as.character(params$nsim),
  HBN_PROSODY_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL = as.character(params$confidence_level),
  HBN_PROSODY_MODEL_ROBUSTNESS_MODE = as.character(params$model_robustness_mode),
  HBN_PROSODY_FAMILY1_AGE_SPEC = as.character(params$family1_age_specification),
  HBN_PROSODY_FAMILY2_COUNT_AGE_SPEC = as.character(params$family2_count_age_specification),
  HBN_PROSODY_FAMILY2_DURATION_AGE_SPEC = as.character(params$family2_duration_age_specification),
  HBN_PROSODY_SPEAKER_REF = as.character(params$speaker_reference_level),
  HBN_PROSODY_CHILD_SEX_REF = as.character(params$child_sex_reference_level),
  HBN_PROSODY_CITY_REF = as.character(params$city_reference_level),
  HBN_PROSODY_PRIMARY_MEASURES = collapse_param_values(params$primary_acoustic_measures),
  HBN_PROSODY_SENSITIVITY_MEASURES = collapse_param_values(params$sensitivity_acoustic_measures)
)
old_report_environment <- Sys.getenv(names(report_overrides), unset = NA_character_)
knitr::knit_hooks$set(document = local({
  previous_hook <- knitr::knit_hooks$get("document")
  function(x) {
    Sys.unsetenv(names(old_report_environment)[is.na(old_report_environment)])
    present <- !is.na(old_report_environment)
    if (any(present)) do.call(Sys.setenv, as.list(old_report_environment[present]))
    previous_hook(x)
  }
}))
do.call(Sys.setenv, as.list(report_overrides))
source(file.path(report_root, "R", "00_setup.R"), local = TRUE)
for (helper in c("table_helpers.R", "data_helpers.R", "model_helpers.R",
                 "diagnostics_helpers.R", "prediction_helpers.R", "plotting_helpers.R")) {
  source(file.path(analysis_paths$functions_dir, helper), local = TRUE)
}
load_required_packages(attach = FALSE)
if (!is.logical(params$run_workflow) || length(params$run_workflow) != 1L || is.na(params$run_workflow)) {
  stop("run_workflow must be TRUE or FALSE.")
}
if (!length(analysis_options$primary_acoustic_measures)) stop("At least one primary acoustic measure is required.")
if (isTRUE(params$run_workflow)) {
  # A new run writes all results again.
  ensure_analysis_directories()
} else {
  # Without a new run, the report is built from the saved results of the last run.
  saved_manifests <- file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, c("family1_manifest.csv", "family2_manifest.csv"))
  if (!all(file.exists(saved_manifests))) {
    stop(sprintf("No saved results were found in %s. Set run_workflow to true and knit again.",
      analysis_paths$outputs_reports), call. = FALSE)
  }
}
```

# Purpose and execution order

Open this file in RStudio and click **Knit**. Knitting runs the whole analysis
in this order:

1. data preparation,
2. Family 1 models,
3. Family 2 models,
4. tables and figures.

After that, this report is built. Knitting can take a long time.

Family 1 models describe each acoustic measure by speaker and child age.
Family 2 models relate the vocalisations of the key child (count and duration
per hour) to each acoustic measure. The 8 primary measures give 8 Family 1
models and 16 Family 2 models (one count model and one duration model for each
measure).

## Settings and safe reuse

The settings are in the `params` block at the top of this file. Change them
there before you knit.

- `nsim`: number of simulations for the prediction intervals. The default is 1000.
- `confidence_level`: the default is 0.95.
- `model_robustness_mode`: `strict` or `auto`. With `auto`, a model that cannot
  be fitted is tried again with another optimizer. The formula is never changed.
- Age specification: `none`, `linear` or `quadratic`. It is set separately for
  Family 1, Family 2 count and Family 2 duration models.
- Reference levels for speaker, child sex and city.
- The lists of primary and sensitivity measures.

SES is used as a number: primary_school = 1, high_school = 2, Intermediate = 3,
bachelor = 4, master = 5.

The folders of the input data and the results folder are set in `config.yaml`
in the project root. The report and all tables, figures and models are saved in
`results/prosody-stats` inside the data folder.

Every knit with `run_workflow: true` fits all models again and writes the
results again. If you change the list of primary measures, empty the results
folder first. Otherwise the files of the removed measures stay there and are
mixed into the summary tables.

With `run_workflow: false` the models are not fitted again. The report is then
built from the saved results of the last run. Keep the other settings as they
were in that run.

The results contain participant-level research data. They must stay private.
Do not share the report, the tables, the figures or the models without a review.

# Scientific execution

The next four parts run the analysis.

## Fit Family 1 and export predictions, plots, diagnostics and contrasts

```{r fit-family1-models, eval=params$run_workflow, results='hide'}
prosody_long <- read_csv_required(file.path(analysis_paths$data_derived, "prosody_long.csv"), "prosody_long")
prosody_long <- set_reference_levels(prosody_long)
store_age_day_summary(prosody_long)

family1_bundles <- list()
family1_fixed_effects <- list()
family1_fit_stats <- list()
family1_diagnostics <- list()
family1_vif_tables <- list()
family1_emmeans <- list()
family1_pairs <- list()

for (outcome_name in analysis_options$primary_acoustic_measures) {
  output_stub <- build_model_stub("family1", outcome_name)
  formula <- build_family_1_formula(outcome_name)
  bundle <- fit_prosody_model(
    data = prosody_long,
    formula = formula,
    model_family = "family_1",
    response_name = outcome_name,
    acoustic_measure = outcome_name
  )

  prediction_grid <- build_age_speaker_grid(bundle, bundle$analysis_data)
  prediction_data <- compute_monte_carlo_ci(bundle, prediction_grid)
  prediction_csv <- file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_predictions, sprintf("%s_predictions.csv", output_stub))
  write_csv_output(prediction_data, prediction_csv)

  prediction_plot <- plot_age_speaker_predictions(bundle, prediction_data, bundle$analysis_data, y_label = outcome_name)
  prediction_plot_path <- file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_plots, sprintf("%s_predictions.png", output_stub))
  save_plot(prediction_plot, prediction_plot_path)

  forest_plot <- plot_fixed_effects_forest(bundle)
  forest_plot_path <- file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_plots, sprintf("%s_forest.png", output_stub))
  save_plot(forest_plot, forest_plot_path, width = 8, height = 4.8)

  diagnostics <- run_model_diagnostics(bundle, output_stub = output_stub)
  vif_summary <- vif_table(bundle)
  emmeans_summary <- estimate_speaker_emmeans(bundle)
  pairs_summary <- estimate_speaker_pairs(bundle)

  save_model_bundle(bundle, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_models, sprintf("%s.rds", output_stub)))
  write_csv_output(extract_fixed_effects(bundle), file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, sprintf("%s_fixed_effects.csv", output_stub)))
  write_csv_output(model_fit_statistics(bundle), file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, sprintf("%s_fit_stats.csv", output_stub)))
  write_csv_output(vif_summary, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, sprintf("%s_vif.csv", output_stub)))
  write_csv_output(emmeans_summary, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, sprintf("%s_emmeans.csv", output_stub)))
  write_csv_output(pairs_summary, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, sprintf("%s_speaker_pairs.csv", output_stub)))

  family1_bundles[[outcome_name]] <- bundle
  family1_fixed_effects[[outcome_name]] <- extract_fixed_effects(bundle)
  family1_fit_stats[[outcome_name]] <- model_fit_statistics(bundle)
  family1_diagnostics[[outcome_name]] <- diagnostics$summary
  family1_vif_tables[[outcome_name]] <- vif_summary
  family1_emmeans[[outcome_name]] <- emmeans_summary
  family1_pairs[[outcome_name]] <- pairs_summary
}

family1_manifest <- bind_rows_safe(lapply(names(family1_bundles), function(outcome_name) {
  data.frame(
    outcome = outcome_name,
    model_path = file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_models, sprintf("%s.rds", build_model_stub("family1", outcome_name))),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
write_csv_output(family1_manifest, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "family1_manifest.csv"))
```

## Fit Family 2 count and duration models and export their results

```{r fit-family2-models, eval=params$run_workflow, results='hide'}
prosody_long <- read_csv_required(file.path(analysis_paths$data_derived, "prosody_long.csv"), "prosody_long")
prosody_long <- set_reference_levels(prosody_long)
store_age_day_summary(prosody_long)

family2_count_bundles <- list()
family2_duration_bundles <- list()
family2_fixed_effects <- list()
family2_fit_stats <- list()
family2_diagnostics <- list()
family2_vif_tables <- list()

for (acoustic_measure in analysis_options$primary_acoustic_measures) {
  standardized <- standardize_predictor(prosody_long, acoustic_measure)
  prosody_long_with_z <- standardized$data
  predictor_name <- standardized$standardized_name

  for (model_spec in list(
    list(model_family = "family_2_count", response_name = "key_child_count_per_hour", adjustment_name = "input_count_per_hour"),
    list(model_family = "family_2_duration", response_name = "key_child_duration_per_hour", adjustment_name = "input_duration_per_hour")
  )) {
    output_stub <- build_model_stub(model_spec$model_family, model_spec$response_name, acoustic_measure)
    formula <- build_family_2_formula(
      outcome_name = model_spec$response_name,
      predictor_name = predictor_name,
      adjustment_name = model_spec$adjustment_name,
      model_family = model_spec$model_family
    )

    bundle <- fit_prosody_model(
      data = prosody_long_with_z,
      formula = formula,
      model_family = model_spec$model_family,
      response_name = model_spec$response_name,
      acoustic_measure = acoustic_measure,
      standardized_predictor = predictor_name
    )

    prediction_grid <- build_predictor_speaker_grid(bundle, bundle$analysis_data, predictor_name)
    prediction_data <- compute_monte_carlo_ci(bundle, prediction_grid)
    names(prediction_data)[names(prediction_data) == predictor_name] <- predictor_name
    prediction_csv <- file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_predictions, sprintf("%s_predictions.csv", output_stub))
    write_csv_output(prediction_data, prediction_csv)

    prediction_plot <- plot_predictor_speaker_predictions(bundle, prediction_data, bundle$analysis_data, predictor_name, y_label = model_spec$response_name)
    prediction_plot_path <- file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_plots, sprintf("%s_predictions.png", output_stub))
    save_plot(prediction_plot, prediction_plot_path, width = 10, height = 4.8)

    forest_plot <- plot_fixed_effects_forest(bundle)
    forest_plot_path <- file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_plots, sprintf("%s_forest.png", output_stub))
    save_plot(forest_plot, forest_plot_path, width = 8, height = 4.8)

    diagnostics <- run_model_diagnostics(bundle, output_stub = output_stub)
    vif_summary <- vif_table(bundle)

    save_model_bundle(bundle, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_models, sprintf("%s.rds", output_stub)))
    write_csv_output(extract_fixed_effects(bundle), file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, sprintf("%s_fixed_effects.csv", output_stub)))
    write_csv_output(model_fit_statistics(bundle), file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, sprintf("%s_fit_stats.csv", output_stub)))
    write_csv_output(vif_summary, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, sprintf("%s_vif.csv", output_stub)))

    if (identical(model_spec$model_family, "family_2_count")) {
      family2_count_bundles[[acoustic_measure]] <- bundle
    } else {
      family2_duration_bundles[[acoustic_measure]] <- bundle
    }
    family2_fixed_effects[[output_stub]] <- extract_fixed_effects(bundle)
    family2_fit_stats[[output_stub]] <- model_fit_statistics(bundle)
    family2_diagnostics[[output_stub]] <- diagnostics$summary
    family2_vif_tables[[output_stub]] <- vif_summary
  }
}

family2_manifest <- bind_rows_safe(c(
  lapply(names(family2_count_bundles), function(acoustic_measure) {
    data.frame(
      model_family = "family_2_count",
      acoustic_measure = acoustic_measure,
      model_path = file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_models, sprintf("%s.rds", build_model_stub("family_2_count", "key_child_count_per_hour", acoustic_measure))),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }),
  lapply(names(family2_duration_bundles), function(acoustic_measure) {
    data.frame(
      model_family = "family_2_duration",
      acoustic_measure = acoustic_measure,
      model_path = file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_models, sprintf("%s.rds", build_model_stub("family_2_duration", "key_child_duration_per_hour", acoustic_measure))),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
))
write_csv_output(family2_manifest, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "family2_manifest.csv"))
```

## Aggregate scientific tables and descriptives

```{r create-tables-plots, eval=params$run_workflow, results='hide'}
prosody_long <- read_csv_required(file.path(analysis_paths$data_derived, "prosody_long.csv"), "prosody_long")

participant_descriptives <- prosody_long |>
  dplyr::distinct(.data$participant_id, .data$age_days, .data$age_months, .data$age_z, .data$SES, .data$child_sex, .data$city) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_participants = dplyr::n(),
    mean_age_days = mean(.data$age_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age_days = stats::sd(.data$age_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_age_months = mean(.data$age_months, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age_months = stats::sd(.data$age_months, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

speaker_descriptives <- prosody_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$speaker) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_rows = dplyr::n(),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(analysis_options$primary_acoustic_measures), list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = ~stats::sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

acoustic_correlations <- prosody_long |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(analysis_options$primary_acoustic_measures)) |>
  stats::cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs") |>
  as.data.frame()

pca_summary <- prosody_long |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::matches("^(wav2vec|hubert)_PC[123]$"), list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = ~stats::sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))
  )

family1_fixed_files <- list.files(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, pattern = "^family1__.*_fixed_effects\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
family2_count_files <- list.files(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, pattern = "^family_2_count__.*_fixed_effects\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
family2_duration_files <- list.files(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, pattern = "^family_2_duration__.*_fixed_effects\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
fit_stat_files <- list.files(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, pattern = "_fit_stats\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
vif_files <- list.files(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, pattern = "_vif\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
diagnostic_files <- list.files(analysis_paths$outputs_diagnostics, pattern = "_diagnostics_summary\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

read_csv_list <- function(paths) {
  bind_rows_safe(lapply(paths, function(path) read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
}

write_csv_output(participant_descriptives, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "participant_descriptives.csv"))
write_csv_output(speaker_descriptives, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "speaker_descriptives.csv"))
write_csv_output(acoustic_correlations, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "acoustic_correlations.csv"))
write_csv_output(pca_summary, file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "pca_summary.csv"))
write_csv_output(read_csv_list(family1_fixed_files), file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "family1_fixed_effects_summary.csv"))
write_csv_output(read_csv_list(family2_count_files), file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "family2_count_fixed_effects_summary.csv"))
write_csv_output(read_csv_list(family2_duration_files), file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "family2_duration_fixed_effects_summary.csv"))
write_csv_output(read_csv_list(fit_stat_files), file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "model_fit_statistics_summary.csv"))
write_csv_output(read_csv_list(vif_files), file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "vif_summary.csv"))
write_csv_output(read_csv_list(diagnostic_files), file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, "diagnostics_summary.csv"))

```{r report-helpers, include=FALSE}
read_output_csv <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_tables, name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop(sprintf("Missing required analysis table: %s", name))
  utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
}
render_table <- function(data, caption = NULL, digits = 3) {
  if (is.null(data) || nrow(as.data.frame(data)) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  print(knitr::kable(as.data.frame(data), caption = caption, digits = digits))
  invisible(data)
}
show_table <- function(x, digits = 3, caption = NULL) render_table(x, caption, digits)
render_image <- function(path, width = "88%") {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Missing required analysis image.")
  # Emit actual knitr image output: handles spaces and self-contained HTML.
  cat(knitr::asis_output(sprintf('<img src="%s" style="width:%s" />\n\n',
      gsub("&", "&amp;", normalizePath(path, winslash = "/"), fixed = TRUE), width)))
}
list_plot_paths <- function(pattern, directory = analysis_paths$outputs_plots) {
  sort(list.files(directory, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE))
}
bundle_output_stub <- function(bundle) {
  if (identical(bundle$model_family, "family_1")) return(build_model_stub("family1", bundle$response_name))
  build_model_stub(bundle$model_family, bundle$response_name, bundle$acoustic_measure)
}
load_manifest_bundles <- function(manifest) {
  if (!nrow(manifest) || !"model_path" %in% names(manifest) || !all(file.exists(manifest$model_path))) {
    stop("Incomplete model manifest; rerun using fresh outputs.")
  }
  bundles <- lapply(manifest$model_path, load_model_bundle)
  names(bundles) <- manifest$model_path
  bundles
}
render_bundle_section <- function(bundle) {
  output_stub <- bundle_output_stub(bundle)
  cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n### Model formula\n\n```r\n", output_stub))
  cat(paste(deparse(bundle$fitted_formula), collapse = " "))
  cat("\n```\n\n")
  show_table(model_fit_statistics(bundle), caption = "Model fit statistics")
  show_table(extract_fixed_effects(bundle), caption = "Fixed effects")
  random_effects <- tryCatch(tidy_model_random_effects(bundle$model, conf.int = TRUE),
    error = function(e) data.frame(note = conditionMessage(e)))
  show_table(random_effects, caption = "Random effects")
  cat("\n### Full model summary\n\n```text\n")
  print(summary(bundle$model))
  cat("\n```\n\n### Saved figures\n\n")
  render_image(file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_plots, sprintf("%s_forest.png", output_stub)))
  render_image(file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_plots, sprintf("%s_predictions.png", output_stub)))
  for (suffix in c("residual_vs_fitted", "qq", "observed_vs_fitted")) {
    render_image(file.path(analysis_paths$outputs_diagnostics, sprintf("%s_%s.png", output_stub, suffix)), "80%")
  }
}
family1_fixed <- read_output_csv("family1_fixed_effects_summary.csv")
family2_count_fixed <- read_output_csv("family2_count_fixed_effects_summary.csv")
family2_duration_fixed <- read_output_csv("family2_duration_fixed_effects_summary.csv")
fit_stats <- read_output_csv("model_fit_statistics_summary.csv")
diagnostics_summary <- read_output_csv("diagnostics_summary.csv")
vif_summary <- read_output_csv("vif_summary.csv")
participant_descriptives <- read_output_csv("participant_descriptives.csv")
speaker_descriptives <- read_output_csv("speaker_descriptives.csv")
missingness_summary <- read_output_csv("missingness_summary.csv")
complete_case_counts <- read_output_csv("complete_case_counts.csv")
merge_summary <- read_output_csv("merge_summary.csv")
acoustic_correlations <- read_output_csv("acoustic_correlations.csv")
pca_summary <- read_output_csv("pca_summary.csv")
variation_checks <- read_output_csv("variation_checks.csv")
family1_manifest <- read_output_csv("family1_manifest.csv")
family2_manifest <- read_output_csv("family2_manifest.csv")
if (nrow(family1_manifest) != length(analysis_options$primary_acoustic_measures) ||
    nrow(family2_manifest) != 2L * length(analysis_options$primary_acoustic_measures)) stop("Unexpected model count.")
model_bundles <- c(load_manifest_bundles(family1_manifest), load_manifest_bundles(family2_manifest))
selection_table <- selection_table_from_bundles(model_bundles)
```

# Project overview and data sources

This analysis builds one table with one row for each participant and speaker.
It uses these input files:

- `participant_speaker_acoustic_features.csv`: the acoustic features,
- `final_master.csv`, `input_long.csv` and `input_output_long.csv`: the
  participant data and the vocal input and output data,
- `participant_lookup.csv`: the participant identifiers,
- `metadata_cleaned.xlsx`: the cleaned metadata. This file is optional. The
  merge notes say if it was found.

The folders of these files are set in `config.yaml`. Acoustic features are not
extracted here.

# Active modelling configuration

```{r active-model-config}
active_model_config <- data.frame(
  setting = c("run_workflow", "nsim", "model_robustness_mode", "family1 age specification",
    "family2 count age specification", "family2 duration age specification", "confidence_level",
    "speaker reference", "child sex reference", "city reference"),
  value = c(params$run_workflow, params$nsim, analysis_options$model_robustness_mode,
    get_family_age_specification("family_1"), get_family_age_specification("family_2_count"),
    get_family_age_specification("family_2_duration"), analysis_options$confidence_level,
    analysis_config$reference_levels$speaker, analysis_config$reference_levels$child_sex,
    analysis_config$reference_levels$city), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
show_table(active_model_config, caption = "Active modelling configuration")
show_table(selection_table, caption = "Saved model bundle manifest")
```

# Model Family 1 results

Default formula (the outcome remains in its original acoustic units):

`acoustic_measure ~ speaker * age_z + SES_num + child_sex + city + (1 | participant_id)`

```{r family1-tables}
render_table(family1_fixed, "Model Family 1 fixed effects")
```

```{r family1-plots, results='asis'}
for (path in list_plot_paths("^family1__.*_(forest|predictions)\\.png$")) render_image(path)
```

```{r family1-model-summaries, results='asis'}
family1_bundles <- Filter(function(bundle) identical(bundle$model_family, "family_1"), model_bundles)
for (bundle in family1_bundles) render_bundle_section(bundle)
```

# Model Family 2 count results

Default formula (acoustic predictor standardized, vocal input main effect only):

`key_child_count_per_hour ~ acoustic_measure_z * speaker + input_count_per_hour + age_z + SES_num + child_sex + city + (1 | participant_id)`
